offline_preview_scope: Captured tet boundary and transferred vertex colors with a simple orthographic raster and synthetic directional shading; not the Newton path tracer or endoscopic camera.

mapping.parameterization: deterministic cylindrical coordinates from principal axis
mapping.sampling: bilinear, wrap around circumference, clamp at ends, sRGB decoded before interpolation
mapping.deformation_binding: sampled linear RGB is stored per FEM node and therefore moves with the deformed tet surface

checks.newton_endoscope_render: not run: Windows environment lacks Newton/Warp runtime; attempted rollout remains live but silent
checks.offline_surface_preview: generated and visually inspected; shows colors transferred to the curved appendix mesh but not endoscopic realism

limitations: The principal-axis cylindrical mapping is synthetic and is not camera-to-mesh or patient-space registration.
The source RGB candidate may contain illumination, highlights, and tissue outside the appendix; no intrinsic albedo or BRDF was recovered.
No endoscopic render, human visual review, or clinical appearance validation has been performed for this mapping.
privacy: Source videos, generated texture pixels, and local rendered frames remain in the git-ignored out/ directory; this tracked report stores hashes and aggregate color statistics only.
